inputs.original_text: The money was recovered from Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, who served as chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee during the procurement process. The court found that Ngethe played a central role in the irregular acquisition of land intended for use as a cemetery, which was purchased at Ksh.283 million despite being unsuitable.
inputs.modified_text: Public office is a trust, not a licence to gamble with taxpayers’ money. The court found Mary Ngechi Ngethe played a central role in acquiring unsuitable cemetery land at a cost of Ksh.283 million. Families who work hard and pay their taxes should not be made to carry the cost of such failures. Recovering the money and holding officials accountable are basic duties of government—and necessary to preserve public trust.
